subject.title: feat(webchat): reply-to a message with hydrated reply context

question: Should WebChat formally adopt the optional `chat.send.replyToId` protocol and Gateway-side hydration as its durable reply behavior, replacing the persisted-message inline-quote path?
rationale: The patch is additive and follows the merged Discord precedent, but it creates a user-visible WebChat interaction and an exposed Gateway protocol field whose long-term cross-client semantics need owner confirmation.

options.title: Adopt the shared reply contract
options.body: Confirm `replyToId` plus Gateway hydration as the WebChat reply path after real user-path proof demonstrates the persisted and offline behavior.

options.title: Keep inline quoting for WebChat
options.body: Retain the existing message-body quote behavior until maintainers define a broader reply API and client rollout plan.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared reply contract
recommendation.body: Confirm `replyToId` plus Gateway hydration as the WebChat reply path after real user-path proof demonstrates the persisted and offline behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the merged Discord precedent, authored the relevant Gateway follow-up, and are assigned to the current PR.
